people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: “The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.
translations.bsb: The holy garments that belong to Aaron will belong to his sons after him, so they can be anointed and ordained in them.
translations.kjv: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons' after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated
translations.asv: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.
